moves.name: Boot Up
moves.notes: Always followed by Hammer Uppercut. Always used at the start of combat. Only an Axebot revived by Stock starts from this move. The original Axebot does not open with this and instead starts directly with "Hammer Uppercut".

moves.name: Hammer Uppercut
moves.notes: Always followed by The One-Two. Always used at the start of combat. The original Axebot starts from this move. Only a new Axebot created after death by Stock switches its opener to "Boot Up".

enemy.pattern_text: Shows this enemy's repeating move order. Starts with Stock 2. Stock X: When killed, a new Axebot is summoned in its place (with Stock X - 1).
